--- Page 4 --- Sechengani - 2007 King - Hajalsa Sechapa kaatgipa:- DIRECTOR, ART&CULTURE DEPARTMENT MEGHALAYA, SHILLONG --- Page 5 --- Ia chonbegipa Dakmesokani kitap, angni skanggipa depante Atchio Jakgitel Dekkim Bajakra Konal Marakni January 26-0 aro gnigipa depante Atchian Salario Cheande Babra Koknal Marakni December 25-0 atchiani salko gisik raaniaona ongchina.

--- Page 6 --- DAKMESOKANIO BAK RAGIPARANG Kalim : Chadambe dolni dilgipa Ringanchi : Kalimni jikgipa Pangkim : Kalimni ripeng Jengku : Chadambe dolni dilgipa Bakkam : Chadambe dolni dilgipa Singkam : Pangkimni ripeng Ringanchi pagipa aro magipa Pekgipa aro Kore Norime : Ringanchini ripeng Rakseng : Ukil Jakkam : Chadambe dolko dilgipa gitcham Songni Buchuma Songni meapa sakgni DAKMESOKANIONAKATGIJABIMUNGMANGMANGCHI BAK MANPAGIPARANG Kalinni nogipa aro uni segipa Kalinni jonggipa Brengja, Roka, Akrem : Membor chakatgiparang --- Page 7 --- JANAPCHENGANI ong""a obostarangko rae uko jinmani mikkango dakmesokate namdapataona ra:bana miksonge setoka.
Apsandake ia angni skanggipa dakmesokaniko seanio angaba apsan miksonganionan ongachim, indiba chongmotgipa gisiko chanchianiko donmitape anga iano kandikbee kosakgilgilkosan mesokaha.
Ia dakmesokanio anga darang a:sakni mandena ongchongmota obosatako rae sejaha aro darang mandeni bimungko ba uni kam cholonko nirikkie seanikoba dakjaha.
Indiba maibakai badiabarango apsan apsan dakangode uan onggakanisan ongaigen.

Anga angni sea-jotani a'bao remikkangengon na'simangni dakchakachi kinggni (SIKKIME aro WALMINDIK A-GILSAK) novel-rango chusokgipa ongaha aro da'o ia Drama-ko seanioba na simangni dakchakaniko nisamsoenga.
aro saoba ia segimin dakmesokaniko namdapatna angna kurpatianiko On'atgenchimode anga uko mitelbegen.
Bon kame ia dakmesokaniko bimang ong'atna kam ka engmitingo angna dakchakgipa Dr.
Carolline R.
Marak, Head of the Garo Department, NElIU.
Iura-ko gisikni urisokgijanirangko talatdape namdapatna dakchakahanina uko dingtangmancha mitelna namnika.
Apsan somoion bang'a dingtangdingtang nanganirango dachake iako chu'sokatna dakchakahanina Sengjrang N.
Sangma, Department of Garo, Rongrenggre Govt.
Higher Secondary School, Williamnagar-ni Lecturer-koba mitelna namnika.
MIIELA Barnath A.
Sangma, B.A.
(Garo Honours) Nokil Awe, Williamnagar.
--- Page 9 --- DAKMESOKANI-I SKANGGIPANAKATANI (Biap: Songni bakra rikamjoljol songona rama re'pakgipa sambuo) Kalim saksan asonge grapenga.
Unomiting Pangkim jako adin!
lekarangko rae songona dakbagipa ramuko re-bae uko nikea) Pangkim:- (Adita chel-kalaoni) Aia mainasa narade saksan grapenga?
(Kalim mikjrao dake nisoa) Aia, naara grapbebengama, angade da'siode balekesa roatengachim, maiba ong'ama?
(Ging ting rimpe) Hing!
Naara chuba ringama?
Kalim:- Angni dukde dal-beade ongja, indiba Achik me-tra saksani kakket dakgijanichi anga chasongnaba dangtapkugijagipa pekgipa bostuko besa kana nangaha.
Pangkim:- Oh, Achikna ka'sagipa jatni depante, naa mejalo gitok jadil napile chadamberangko mikkangchakc redile, jak goe a'songna chrikdilgipa, daalo mechik saksana chu ringe goka dake grapengama?
Kalim:- Oe, ripeng ua mejalni Kalimchim; indiba daalni Kalimde indake kalimaengjok!
Mejalo noksulni manderangba pangna chu ringpagijagipani peke reangako niksoe suk ongtokjaenga.
Pangkim:- De, naa an'tangan ia pilakko urieba, ukon dakaiode sawade suk ongchakpagnoksa.
Kalim:- Kangale atchigipade pilakko dakon kangala da'ogita maiba mingsako dakna chanchipaoba miksongani chu'sckjajokon dakronggijakoba dakatmanaia.
(1) --- Page 10 --- Pangkim:- Maina naara dositangko kangalatango pakjrake namgijako besa kaenga.
Sawade kangale atchija, angaba apsan nanggitan kangalni depanteanba.
Kalim:- (Rake kik-kike grape) Inghing, kangaloba naade anggitade dukchakkujaenggen.
Salsao anga an'tangna onggipa obostako daalonaba gualkuja.
Unsalo chinga migrichim, anga angni jongtangko ja'tang wate notangko debrae okkria amjae ai-babamangni hajira kam kaako sandimitingo ramao manderangni gadapgimin tebrong bitchil rongsako nikaha.
Ua te-brong bitchilara tongsade a'ningo aro tong'sa akosako nadoe dongachim.
Uko ote so'e an'tangba cha'pana inora angni nogipa aro jonggipan okamanjae una jegrikpilaha.
(Pile rake denggoke graptaia).

Pangkim:- (Kalimni pakkreo rime) Oe, beben angade kangal inoba namkalbatbebe-kuenga, chaa raja chadiljaoba angni ama-apade angni uibachengaoni daalonakingkingba mi patisaba okumude tom'tomatbo (Sakgnian re'anga).
